messages.author: 5afdc17ab676346d
messages.subject: Error building shiny version 0.8.0
parts:
Hi,

I was using Shiny 0.7.0, and when I deployed I saw the message in the browser that I needed at least 0.7.0.  The current release seems to be 0.8.0, so I installed it, however then I got this message on deployment:


Waiting for task: 12605
  building: Parsing manifest
  building: Building 1 packages
  building: Building package shiny-0.8.0
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 12606 error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 12607 failed: Error building package: Error building shiny (0.8.0). Image build exited with non-zero status: 1

Any ideas?
